description: Token bucket rate limiter with injectable clock

signatures.name: TokenBucket
signatures.doc: Allows `capacity` bursts, refilling at `refill_per_sec` tokens per second.

signatures.name: TokenBucket.take
signatures.doc: Consume n tokens. Returns False and consumes nothing if short.

signatures.name: TokenBucket.wait_time
signatures.doc: Seconds until n tokens are available. 0.0 if available now.
